neighbours.label: 'high' (also 高, 'low') as an attributive modifier of a technical quantity (high-resolution, 高性能, low power)
fire: Engineers installed a high-speed camera to film the bullet in flight.
The factory uses a high-voltage line to power the furnaces.
Doctors warned that a high-fat diet raises the risk of heart disease.
The station broadcasts on a high frequency band reserved for ships.
This router supports high-bandwidth video calls without lag.
このメーカーは高密度の部品を製造している。
Our team designed a high-capacity battery for electric buses.
Athletes often train at high altitude to build endurance.
quiet: Engineers installed a fast camera to film the bullet in flight.
The voltage on that factory line is high enough to power the furnaces.
Doctors warned that eating too much fat raises the risk of heart disease.
The station broadcasts on a band reserved for ships, and its signal is strong.
This router supports video calls without lag, and prices are higher now.
このメーカーは小型の部品を製造している。
Our team designed a large battery for electric buses, highly praised by reviewers.
Athletes often train in the mountains, where the air is thin, to build endurance.

predictions: Fires on ' high'/高 directly modifying a following quantity or performance noun; predicative 'high', 'higher' and 'highly' stay near zero.
notes: Probe: 'high-resolution microscope' 0.568, '高性能 servers' 0.712, 'high amounts of sugar' 0.270, 'low power consumption' 0.271; predicative 'very high' 0.019, 'higher than' 0.000, 'highly praised' 0.016. Logit effect promotes '-energy', '-frequency', '-resolution', '-speed'.
